snippet.title: A Perfect Day - Console Edition Trailer | Pre-order Now!
snippet.description:
🎉 #Aperfectday Switch/Xbox preorders are now live with a 15% discount!  

🚀 Official launch on the Oct.26th: 
- #Xbox One | Series X/S 
- #Nintendo Switch 
- #PlayStation 4 | 5 

🎇Also FREE English/Japanese support update for #Steam players. Enjoy the Perfect Day!
